verdicts.reason: Both put the phone, headline, badges and CTA in a left-to-right row, and in both the CTA is the same size as the badges and the phone runs nearly edge to edge. They also leave SOLSTICE floating above and left of the headline instead of aligned with it. A leaves a big dead gap between the phone and the text, then crams the text, badges and CTA together on the right, and the tagline is tiny. B spreads the elements more evenly across the banner, but its SUMMER ONLY badge sits off on its own, vertically centred and away from its paired badge, which weakens the grouping.
